bindings.caption: Prepare cluster TEM grid. Exact deposition volume, solvent and drying procedure unreported. TEM cannot resolve nanostructures at high resolution; approximately 1.5 nm dark spots also occur on empty grid and cannot be assigned as MSC diameter. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply. Heating device type is unreported unless explicitly specified.
